message: Phase 1 IMU frame adapter: /livox/lio_imu_raw -> /livox/lio_imu, output frame_id=lio_imu_link. This node only rewrites header.frame_id; it does not publish TF, filter IMU data, or modify measurements.

Canonical LIO adapter: adapting /simulation/ground_truth/odom to /odometry/lio through TF base_link->sensor with gimbal frame gimbal_yaw_link. raw_odom_parent_frame_mode=canonical_odom. twist_mode=passthrough. Real hardware still requires calibrated and timestamped gimbal yaw. input_health=disabled.
Phase 1 placeholder: publishing dynamic identity map -> odom. Remove this node when real global localization is connected.
Phase 1 skeleton: publishing gimbal_yaw_joint on /joint_states. Real hardware must provide timestamped gimbal yaw before rotating-gimbal localization is accepted.
Simulation-only scan adapter: /simulation/scan_raw -> /scan with frame_id=sim_lidar_link. No TF is published.
